highlights: Subtle dot pattern on hero background using grid overlay at opacity 30% (dark mode: 15%)
Texture overlay using /layout/texture-shade.png at 50% opacity in light mode, 100% in dark mode with multiply blend mode on footer
Grid pattern: 120px x 120px repeating grid lines in cream color, positioned at calc(50%+60px) with 30% opacity (dark: 15%)
Ruler decorations: vertical and horizontal ruler patterns along edges at 40% opacity (dark: 20%) on wide viewports
Diagonal geometric shapes with triangular clip-paths positioned absolutely for decorative page sections
Soft shadows on cards and elevated surfaces using inset shadows on buttons: inset 0 1px #ffffff1f, inset 0 -1px #0000001f
Box shadows on controls with multiple layers for depth: 0 2px 4px #00000020 for cards
PUI shadow system with layered shadows on controls, thumbs, sliders, and swatches using rgba with fine-tuned alpha values
Noise/grain texture overlay on surfaces via background image repeating pattern
Canvas elements for rendering dynamic visual effects and borders on interactive components
Rounded corners using corner-shape: superellipse(1.3) on PUI controls for organic feel
